g.title: CMV_QSP
g.text: 이식 후 거대세포바이러스(CMV) 감염 — 정량적 시스템 약리학 지도
Cytomegalovirus in transplant recipients · QSP mechanistic map · 45 ODEs
THRESHOLD 1 (drug) e* = r0/(r0+DELI) = 0.667 · THRESHOLD 2 (immune) E8* = r0/KE8 = 4.8 CD8/µL · CLOCK 2^(Δt/1.2 d) per PCR interval
measured DNAemia = virion DNA (Vv) + lysis DNA (Vl) — polymerase inhibitors cut both, terminase/kinase inhibitors cut only Vv

g.title: cluster_algebra
g.text: 0 · 모델의 축: 두 개의 역치와 하나의 시계 (the spine: two thresholds, one clock)

g.title: cluster_virol
g.text: 1 · CMV 유전자 산물과 약물 표적 (viral gene products = the drug targets)

g.title: cluster_latency
g.text: 2 · 잠복과 재활성화 (latency and the reactivation flux)

g.title: cluster_repl
g.text: 3 · 허용세포 내 복제주기 — 약물이 끼어드는 지점 (replication cycle: where each drug intervenes)

g.title: cluster_dnaemia
g.text: 4 · 혈장 DNA는 두 종류다 [구조적 결정 1] (measured DNAemia is TWO species)

g.title: cluster_gcv
g.text: 5 · 발간시클로버 → 간시클로버: 활성화 단계가 바이러스 유전자 산물이다 [구조적 결정 2]

g.title: cluster_mbv
g.text: 7 · 마리바비르와 간시클로버 길항작용 (maribavir, and the antagonism it creates)

g.title: cluster_other
g.text: 8 · 포스카넷 · 시도포비어 · 면역글로불린 · 세포치료 (salvage agents and immunotherapy)

g.title: cluster_res
g.text: 9 · 내성: 한 번의 돌연변이가 남기는 것의 크기 [구조적 결정 4] (resistance is a SHAPE, not a potency)

g.title: cluster_adapt
g.text: 10 · 적응면역 — 병을 끝내는 것은 약이 아니다 (adaptive immunity: the actual endpoint)

g.title: cluster_is
g.text: 11 · 면역억제의 총량 (the net state of immunosuppression, ISI)

g.title: cluster_kidney
g.text: 13 · 신장: 노출을 정하는 손잡이이자 독성의 표적 [구조적 결정 3 · 후반부]

g.title: cluster_tissue
g.text: 14 · 조직 구획과 장기 질환 (tissue compartment, sanctuary sites, end-organ disease)

g.title: cluster_indirect
g.text: 15 · 간접효과와 이식장기 (indirect effects: the alloimmune consequences of CMV)

g.title: cluster_strategy
g.text: 16 · 예방전략: 감시간격은 용량이다 (prevention strategy — the monitoring interval IS a dose)

g.title: cluster_end
g.text: 17 · 임상 평가변수 (clinical endpoints the model reports)

g.title: cluster_gaps
g.text: 18 · 모델에 없는 것 (deliberate omissions, stated rather than hidden)

g.title: ALG_KPROD
g.text: fixed by doubling 1.2 d + decline t½ 2.4 d

g.title: ALG_E1
g.text: below it → breakthrough, whatever the label says

g.title: ALG_E2
g.text: control with NO drug — the real endpoint

g.title: T_PD
g.text: blocks pac-site CLEAVAGE, not DNA synthesis

g.title: A_NK
g.text: less CNI-sensitive → partial control when T cells are gone

g.title: L_REACT
g.text: reactivation flux into the infected pool

g.title: L_GRAFT
g.text: this is primary infection, not reactivation)

g.title: R_I
g.text: IW (wild type) · IA (UL97 mut) · IB (UL56 mut)

g.title: R_CPE
g.text: loss rate LOSS = DELI + KE8·E8 + KENK·NK

g.title: A_AG
g.text: AG — antigen load = IW + IA + IB + 0.5·IT

g.title: D_MEAS
g.text: ⇒ ~67% of the PCR result is NOT virion

g.title: G_PL
g.text: V 60 L · CL 13 L/h at CrCl 100 · t½ 3.2 h

g.title: G_TP
g.text: 66 µM at 900 od · 133 µM at 900 BID

g.title: T_PL
g.text: V 45 L · CL 2.6 L/h · t½ 12 h

g.title: T_DDI
g.text: DDI: letermovir is a CYP3A + OATP1B1

g.title: B_LTV0
g.text: — the entire marrow argument for switching

g.title: O_VS
g.text: ⇒ can rise while plasma PCR is negative

g.title: M_PL
g.text: V 27 L · CL 3.5 L/h · t½ ~5 h

g.title: M_NET
g.text: net when combined with GCV 900 BID

g.title: F_PL
g.text: V 40 L · CL 6.5 L/h (95% renal) · Cavg ~640 µM

g.title: F_PD
g.text: binds the pol PPi site — NEEDS NO ACTIVATION

g.title: I_VAC
g.text: pp65 DNA) — not in the ODEs

g.title: X_UL54
g.text: (in the map and the table; NOT a separate ODE strain)

g.title: X_SHAPE
g.text: both are ONE mutation. Only the ganciclovir one
leaves anything to escalate — and even there the
required GCV-TP is 2.0× the licensed treatment dose,
so the drug must be CHANGED, not increased.

g.title: E_RES
g.text: peak resistant-strain share of virion DNA

g.title: X_WIN
g.text: sub-threshold e (0 < e < e*) — created by
renal dose bands, ANC dose cuts, poor adherence,

g.title: A_THR
g.text: the count at which the exponent is negative

g.title: A_LATE
g.text: valGCV 200 d arm leaves E8 far below E8*
when the drug stops → the exponent restarts

g.title: P_CMI
g.text: stop prophylaxis when E8 crosses E8*
— the strategy the model argues for

g.title: P_LATE
g.text: the cost of prophylaxis, in the model's own terms:
the drug removed the antigen that builds E8

g.title: S_BAL
g.text: lowering ISI helps the virus arm and
raises the rejection hazard — the model prices both

g.title: K_BAND
g.text: RENAL DOSE BANDS ARE A TWO-EDGED FIX
they protect the marrow but spend the margin over e*

g.title: K_ERR
g.text: the opposite error: NOT reducing the dose
CrCl 30 on 900 od → GCV Cavg 13.2 µM,

g.title: O_VT
g.text: the variable the DISEASE hazard reads

g.title: O_PNE
g.text: (commonest and most lethal after HSCT / lung Tx)

g.title: O_COMP
g.text: (why a negative plasma PCR does not exclude colitis)

g.title: N_LOOP
g.text: → more CMV. And treating the neutropenia by

g.title: P_RISK
g.text: (HSCT: R+ is the high-risk group — reversed)

g.title: P_UNIV
g.text: valGCV 100 d vs 200 d · letermovir 200 d

g.title: P_PRE
g.text: PCR every Δt, treat at a trigger,

g.title: P_CLOCK
g.text: ⇒ a 1000 IU/mL trigger read weekly IS a 57,000 trigger

g.title: P_SEC
g.text: relapse when E8 is still below E8*

g.title: E_COST
g.text: drug days · number of PCRs · total cost

g.title: Z1
g.text: UL54 mutants as a separate ODE strain
(present in the map and cross-resistance table only)

g.title: Z4
g.text: AMPPK has no direct human measurement
